verification: JSDOM event and semantic DOM checks only; browser rendering, native drag and Windows integration not verified

checks.name: Runtime edit and default restore count exact string differences, including whitespace
Choosing a custom, saved or candidate source with the same value creates no pending change
Typing the original runtime value back removes pending styling and count
Matching result stays independent from pending edits in both matching and mismatching states
Simulated application resets the runtime baseline to the applied string
Runtime pending copy uses pending-application language without draft wording
Matched elements carry the semantic match class; edits refresh that class independently
Editing the second duplicate marks only its stable identity in both original and edited diff
Changing an element back clears replacement annotations without changing its identity
Mixed deletion, addition and movement preserve old identities and serialize only the edited values
Restore reinstates exact initial strings, identities, matching and clean change labels
Empty duplicate positions stay distinct when only the second empty segment is removed
Diff values escape markup and annotations never contaminate serialized or applied data
Whole strings retain semicolons as one replacement and keep actual-value marks separate
Semantic change-state workflows emit no JSDOM runtime errors
